baseline: keyed SHA256 HMAC per canonical field value, scoped to draft/root/field; no raw contact in provenance
revision: positive monotonic site-owned integer; form revision must match locked draft
transaction: select_for_update on draft; validate persisted identity/HMAC/origins; current root GET; revalidate merged contact; persist provenance and create fresh intent atomically; build provider payload afterward
copied_fields: current root contact; present API billing values including clears outrank stored intent; missing billing fields may use saved address with local_saved_address provenance
explicit_fields: retained across saved/rechecked drafts; clear is preserved and must pass existing required-field validation
existing_intent: no fresh merge, no rewrite, no new identity or provider retry; existing immutable operation path only
missing_provenance: hold before new intent; never infer/backfill authorization for historical draft
fresh_get_reuse: in-memory root read only, bound to draft/root/chain revision; reuse within 10 seconds for ownership when previous member is same root; distinct previous child or stale read requires existing verification GET

provider_read.timestamp: normalized only if provider value includes explicit offset; raw provider timestamp and field retained; no observed-time or server-zone substitution
